# inu.vaked.dev — 犬 · 猫 · 馬

> A neighbourhood animal-care service by Peter Lodri: dog walking, cat visits
> and horse care. Japanese (default), English and 中文. Book by QR code or by
> email to inu@8b.is.

## Services
- Dog walking (犬) — 30–60 min, double-clipped leads, photo + note every walk.
- Cat visits (猫) — 30 min, food/water/litter and company.
- Horse care (馬) — stable visits, brushing, hand-walking.

## Pricing (JPY)
- Solo walk, one dog — from ¥1,200 (30 min) / ¥2,000 (60 min)
- Pack walk, 2–3 dogs — from ¥1,500 for the first dog, ¥900 each extra
- Cat visit — from ¥1,500 · Horse care — from ¥4,500 (60 min)
- Monthly pass — 20 walks ¥18,000
- First meet & greet is free.

## Contact
- Email: inu@8b.is
- QR: https://inu.vaked.dev/assets/qr.svg (scans to a prefilled email)
- Languages: 日本語 · English · 中文
